subject: Social Media
title: Platform Lock-In
description: A short lesson to help you apply Platform Lock-In.

hook.text: You want to leave Facebook. But your photos, friends, and groups are there. Your social life is hostage.

buildup.text: Lock-in is the cost of switching. The more you invest in a platform, the harder it gets to leave.

discovery.text: Network effects amplify lock-in. Your friends are on Facebook, so you stay. They stay because you're there.

twist.text: Platforms make data export hard on purpose. Downloading your archive gives you files, not portable relationships.

climax.text: Interoperability—making platforms talk to each other—would break lock-in. That's why Big Tech fights it.

punchline.text: You don't use the platform. The platform uses you.

quiz.question: What is platform lock-in?
options: The high cost of switching away from a platform
